journal.text: I was born in New York, United States.
I wore my birthday cake. Sam kept the photograph.
I grew a little more confident in a world full of things to investigate.
My imaginary dragon joined bedtime stories.
I let Sam help with my shoes.
I borrowed the largest book I could carry.
I started at New York Primary School.
I built a blanket fort that almost met building regulations.
I admitted breaking Sam’s mug.
Another birthday arrived. Some days felt much bigger than others.
Another birthday arrived. Some days felt much bigger than others.
I borrowed the largest book I could carry.
I built a blanket fort that almost met building regulations.
I moved on to New York Secondary School.
I got through an introduction without pretending to be interesting.
I listened to Sam’s old music and the story behind it.
Another birthday arrived. Some days felt much bigger than others.
I challenged a rumour in a group chat.
I agreed on clearer check-ins with Sam.
Another birthday arrived. Some days felt much bigger than others.
I completed secondary education with grades of 92%.
I volunteered at a community garden in New York.
I enrolled at New York University to study computing.
I got through an introduction without pretending to be interesting.
I stopped comparing my evening to everyone else’s highlights.
Another year passed. The ordinary days were part of my life too.
I completed my computing degree with grades of 100%.
Another year passed. The ordinary days were part of my life too.
I started work as a software developer at New York Technology.
My income for the year was $72,000.00; income tax was $9,540.00.
Another year passed. The ordinary days were part of my life too.
I bought City Studio in New York.
I invested in Grove Broad Market Fund.

pending.title: An offer for City Studio
pending.body: A buyer has offered $155,440.35. You still own the property until you accept and settle.

choices.label: Accept the offer
choices.resultBody: The property left your ownership. The mortgage, fees and net proceeds are settled from the actual sale price.
choices.journal: I accepted an offer for City Studio.

choices.label: Wait for another buyer
choices.resultBody: The property remains yours. Its costs continue while you wait for another offer.
choices.journal: I declined an offer for City Studio.
